claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetan astrology treats a person’s pre-incarnation frequency and character as selecting their astrological influences; stars do not determine the person’s life.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She says Taygetan astrological calculations begin at the galactic center, then include local constellations, the Pleiades, and the Taygeta Tau-19 system.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She contrasts this sequence with terrestrial astrology.
